name: Autism Central — diagnosis for adults
description: NHS-hosted Autism Central guidance describing why adults may seek an autism diagnosis and the usual route through a GP or other health professional to specialist assessment.
intended_use: Understand a current England-facing route into adult autism assessment without using an online page as a diagnosis.
audience_or_context: Adults considering autism assessment, families and supporters in England.
limitations: This is guidance rather than an assessment and cannot establish whether someone is autistic.
Local referral routes, waiting times and service criteria vary and may change.
cost_or_access_notes: Publicly accessible online; NHS assessment access depends on local pathways.
conflicts_of_interest: Autism Central is an NHS England-funded programme and links to service information within that system; ND Oracle preserves that institutional context.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
